corpus_source: Council by-election results from Democracy Club candidate and result records, with results checked against the council's own declaration where the review status says so (data/history/byelection-appends.json); each paired with the ward's previous ordinary result by scripts/lib/local-byelection-model.mjs (buildSwingCorpus).

rules.contests: A council by-election for which the corpus holds the same ward's previous ordinary result. Scottish STV contests are excluded, as in the model.
rules.stood_before: A party counts in a contest only if it had 2% or more of the vote both in the previous ordinary result and in the by-election.
rules.measure: Median, over the month's counted contests, of the change in the log-odds of the party's share between the previous ordinary result and the by-election.
rules.points: The same median shown as the percentage point change for a party starting on 25%.
rules.minimum: A party's month is blank when fewer than 5 contests count for it. Blank months are not interpolated. 5 is the model's own minimum for giving a party a swing of its own (MIN_PARTY_N).
rules.window: Months from 2024-07, the month of the July 2024 general election, one of the model's two party-system boundaries.
rules.lanes: Independent and Other are pools of unrelated candidates, so they have no line.
rules.entrants: A party is new to the corpus when its first appearance (as a by-election candidate or in a previous ordinary result) is on or after 2024-07-01. It qualifies when it has stood in at least 5 by-elections. Every other party on the barometer is compared in by-elections with and without it on the ballot, from its first appearance onwards; a side with fewer than 5 contests is blank.
rules.hand_verified_declaration: Contests whose result was checked against the returning officer's own declaration.

parties_not_shown.reason: It stands in no previous ordinary result in the record, so it has no contest where it stood before.
